On Tue, May 19, 2026 at 10:03 AM Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> Kimberly / Jordan — looping you both in. Nimbus asked for a CAIQ crosswalk + named attestors and a swimlane for evidence collection versus signing. Samir wants a first-pass by EOD tomorrow PT.

Thanks — I can take point on the mapping. I pulled a short owner swimlane and draft attestor roster; attaching both. High-level notes inline here:

- CCM:DP-01 (Data encryption in transit):
  - Artifact: TLS config doc (DocID: redwood/doc/tls-2026-01), network runbook extract, sample curl logs (redwood-logs/ingress-2026-03).
  - Owner: Platform Ops (Vivek Kulkarni).
  - Attestor: Head of Platform Security (Jordan Blake) — will attest to configuration and test results.

- CCM:KM-03 (Key rotation & KMS):
  - Artifact: KMS rotation policy (redwood/doc/kms-rotation-v2), HSM integration notes, KMS audit log snippet.
  - Owner: Infra Security (Priya Natarajan).
  - Attestor: Kimberly Park (Compliance) — attestation for policy and retention.

- CCM:TI-02 (Tenant isolation):
  - Artifact: Tenant isolation design doc, network ACL snapshots, runtime telemetry sample (s3://redwood-telemetry/tenant-iso/2026-04).
  - Owner: Runtime Engineering (Diego Fernandez).
  - Attestor: Jordan Blake (Security) — signoff on isolation controls and tests.

Action items I will do tonight: populate the redwood_crosswalk_template_v1.csv with entries for the control families above and upload the swimlane and roster. If any owners listed above cannot attest, Jordan / Priya please advise.

I recommend we use a lightweight DocuSign for the attestation (one checkbox per control family + freeform comment). I can prepare the DocuSign envelope once Marissa confirms the final roster.

Regards,
Kimberly Park
Director, Compliance | Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com
